title: Database Read Replica Replication Delay during Heavy Ingestion
description: Read replica replication lag grew to over 180 seconds during a massive data import job on the primary database, resulting in stale data reads on user profile and search endpoints while primary database write probes remain healthy.

initial_fault_report.headline: High Database Replication Lag (185s) & Stale Read Inconsistencies
initial_fault_report.details: User accounts service reporting stale query reads from read replica pool.

telemetry.details: Replication stream byte lag between primary database and read replica nodes reached 185 seconds.
Gateway p99 latency on read endpoints elevated due to read replica query contention.

health_probe.details: Direct synthetic write and primary read probe execute in 1.6ms on database primary.

operational_events.details: Nightly customer data ingestion batch job initiated, saturating replica WAL streaming buffer.
